newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Swire unit, SHK Prop loan soon.
newsitem.headline: Swire unit, SHK Prop loan soon.

text.p: A HK$6.5 billion syndicated loan is expected this week for the residential redevelopment of the former Shiu Wing steel mill site in Hong Kong, bankers said on Monday.
The four-year loan will be launched through a special-purpose company, Arrowtown Assets Ltd, and will be guaranteed by Swire Properties Ltd and Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd, they said.
It pays a margin of 50 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate, they said.
Chase Manhattan Asia, Hang Seng Bank, Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi, Banque Nationale de Paris, Sanwa Bank and Standard Chartered Bank are coordinating arrangers for the loan.
Chase Manhattan Asia and Hang Seng Bank are bookrunners.

Swire Pacific said in April that its wholly-owned Swire Properties Ltd had formed an equally-owned joint venture with Sun Hung Kai Properties to acquire the development rights to the site from Shiu Wing Steel Ltd.
The Swire and Sun Hung Kai arms each own 49 percent of the project, with two percent held by Shiu Wing Steel Ltd.
The site in the Tseung Kwan O area of the New Territories has a development potential of about four million square feet of residential space.
The total project cost is estimated at more than HK$25 billion, spread over a five-year development programme.
